Name: Sceva
Summary: Sceva was a Jewish chief priest whose seven sons attempted to cast out an evil spirit using the name of Jesus whom Paul preached. The possessed man overpowered them, and they fled naked and wounded, so that the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified at Ephesus.
KeyStory: Sceva's seven sons borrowed Paul's Jesus and were beaten naked by the spirit they could not command.
LifeLesson: The name of Jesus is not a charm to borrow. Sceva's sons learned that authority comes from knowing Him, not naming Him.
